title: An automatic lifecycle transition must not touch anything under review
body:
Exclude every memory a reviewer is currently holding: contested ones, and any memory a pending candidate names in replaces. Put the exclusion in the selector the health report reads, not in the driver, so the report cannot name a memory the sweep would decline to touch.

Why: admitMemory refuses a replacement that is no longer effective, so retiring a revision target leaves a candidate review can never approve. The write path proposes revisions and sweeps in the same call, so this is reachable in one operation rather than by a race, and the candidate looks normal until someone presses Admit.

evidence.summary: retirementCandidates excludes contested memories and any id named in a pending candidate's replaces
admitMemory throws replacement_changed_review_again when the named replacement is no longer active or contested
Test asserting a memory a candidate is proposing to revise is not disused

v1.trigger: when adding or changing an automatic lifecycle transition, such as retirement, expiry or any sweep that demotes a memory without human review
